_meta.coverage_metric: planted-defect refusal rate by refusal code. A defect counts only when the checker exits at the status that owns it AND names the code that owns it; a generic failure is not detection, because a checker that fails everything for one reason is indistinguishable from a working one at the exit status. Compiler controls assert the true exit code, captured from the process rather than through a pipeline, because 2 is a refusal and 64 is a tool that could not run and a suite that accepts either cannot tell them apart.
_meta.denominator_source: tests/selftest.py derives its subjects from the tree: every artifact under references/, examples/ and tests/fixtures/ that declares a schema, reconciled in both directions against the schema registry inside scripts/check_prel_contract.py. There is no filename list. A schema registered with no committed artifact is red, an artifact whose schema is unregistered is red, and a control that runs without being declared in cases.json is red.
_meta.scope: This plane records what the local suite decides. It is not the repository skill-eval plane (evals/cases + evals/coverage.json); a claim here is closed by tests/run-all.sh on current repository bytes and by nothing else.
_meta.consumer_canaries: evals/receipts/canary-2026-08-18.receipt.json records Shadow closure audits of two external repositories at named revisions, plus the refused false-PASS attempts. Those lanes are consumer evidence and deliberately outside tests/run-all.sh: they resolve against checkouts this repository does not own, so running them in the suite would make somebody else's commit turn this suite red.
uncovered_by_design: whether a signal statement is true of the real product -- the checker validates evidence grade and shape, never the world
whether the compiled job hypothesis is the right one -- that is a USER-lane judgement with no deterministic oracle
whether an oracle's refutation condition is strong enough -- shape is checkable, adequacy is not
whether a capability edge that nobody declared should exist -- the compiler cannot know what was not observed
